limits.candidate: Recorded headless Chromium/Linux environment, ten CSS widths, normal text, reduced motion and DPR 1. Saved/no-JavaScript, direct and refreshed default currency pages. Query preservation and final selected views are verified separately from the retained non-default-book initial hydration mismatch. No pricing redesign, query initial-render repair, native zoom, other engines, physical devices or spoken screen-reader acceptance. Local redirects are a model; actual Pages HTTP is a separate live gate.
limits.live: Recorded Linux headless Chromium, real default TLS, normal text, reduced motion, DPR 1 and height 1000. Default currency direct entry/reload at 320, 390, 820 and 1440 CSS pixels; selected-book direct entry/reload at 390 pixels. HTTP checks include both slash forms and all six keepsake queries with a benign extra query. No native zoom, other browser engines, physical devices, payments, complete page accessibility acceptance or spoken screen reader testing. Only exact four-document deployment readiness is polled; behavioural observations have no retries. The .nojekyll marker is checked in Git only.
knownLimitations: A static currency document initially contains the default Life Story view. The five non-default keepsake queries still receive that saved book view before the client selects the requested book. This separate selected-book initial-render mismatch is retained, not repaired or accepted as passed.

Observed React 418 hydration errors are recorded individually and tolerated only for a non-default selected-book query with independently confirmed saved-versus-requested book mismatch. Every other runtime, console, network and HTTP error fails this gate.
